newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures close up on shortcovering, pound.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures close up on shortcovering, pound.

text.p: UK wheat futures prices were up 0.35 to 1.15 stg per tonne with 384 lots traded, traders said.
Country shortcovering continues to dominate the futures market and was fuelled on Tuesday by further rises in sterling, they said.
Strong sentiment in the wheat sector carried through to barley which saw the November contract trade up 0.50 stg per tonne to close at 92.50.
"As often happens, people tend to buy a bit of barley if they can't get their hands on wheat," one trader said.
Barley traded up between 0.50 to 1.00 stg on a turnover of 64 lots, double Monday's volume.
